open_points.subject: grant_producer_project
open_points.text: grant_producer_project: [BEHAVIOR] MUST give a pair whose earlier grants are all revoked a new grant, built and inserted exactly as for a pair that never had one, and MUST leave every revoked grant of the pair unchanged; it never updates or reactivates an earlier record.
open_points.other_text: grant_producer_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make its own reads and writes, wherever its other notes call for them, of the records the ServiceIdentityRepository holds through get_producer_grant of the service_identity repository of that transaction, and through its get_service_principal and its insert_producer_grant.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must the repository expose a collection operation that lets the function establish that all earlier grants are revoked, or must the new note be limited to the single grant returned by get_producer_grant?
